nodes.name: gantry
nodes.description: portal on the two rails (legs, sills, rail bogies, head beams, bridge, walkways, ladders, e-house); translates along the block rails; pivot at the ground on the span and gantry centre

nodes.name: trolley
nodes.description: trolley frame and hoist machinery on the bridge rails; translates across the rows; pivot at the top of the bridge rails on the centre line

nodes.name: ropes
nodes.description: four rope strands hanging from the drums, 1 m long at scale 1; no travel limit of its own: the sidecar `stretch` rule scales Y so they reach the head block (2.2 m at rest)

nodes.name: hoist
nodes.description: head block with sheaves and hangers; pivot = container attach plane at rest (raised); travels down (negative)

nodes.name: spreader
nodes.description: telescopic 40 ft spreader hung from the head block, long axis along the rails; small float travel

gantry.note: the rail run is per block (engine owns the real limits); +Z is the engine gantry axis

trolley.note: reaches the outer rows (row centres at +-10.15 m) and the outer WTP pads (about +-10.8 m)

attachPoints.name: container
attachPoints.description: centre of the twist-lock plane, i.e. the TOP of the carried box (long axis along the rails, hence yawDeg 90 for a box modelled along X). The plane is 18.0 m above the ground at hoist 0: hoist = (box bottom + box height) - 18.0

attachPoints.name: twistlock_fl
attachPoints.source: ISO 1161 casting centres of a 40 ft box (twist-lock positions at hoist rest)

stretch.note: ropes scale Y = (ropes.y - (hoist.y + offsetM)) / unitLengthM, both children of the trolley; 2.2 at rest

hoist.note: lowest plane = top of a 40 ft high-cube box standing on the ground; restAttachM suits a 5-high stack plus the engine travel clearance; taller blocks scale the model vertically (see ascAssets.ts)

stack.note: 8 rows at 2.9 m pitch inside the 25.4 m span (the engine row pitch); a carried box clears a 5-high stack by the engine travel clearance

branding.note: ZPMC wordmark set in Montserrat ExtraBold on the blue atlas (no official logo artwork); numbered bridge panels over the rows; no operator branding

provenance.fact: 25.4 m rail span over 8 container rows, 40 t rated load
dark/medium-blue rail-mounted gantry: twin box-beam bridge, vertical legs on sills with rail bogies, trolley with hoist machinery, yellow spreader
leg, girder, trolley and e-house proportions; 24.7 m overall height; bridge underside 20.0 m
provenance.reason: no manufacturer drawing in the repo; sized so a 5-high stack plus a carried box fits under the bridge

provenance.fact: portal length 9.4 m (sill) plus buffers, so two ASCs fit the engine 12 m minimum centre separation
40 ft spreader with end beams, telescopic tubes and four twist-locks at the ISO 1161 casting centres
ZPMC wordmark and "40 t" baked into the atlas, numbered bridge panels 1..8 over the rows; no operator branding
rope strands are a scaled node (rest length follows the hoist); stiffener ribs, grating and rungs as boxes
